Abstract. In general, Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) models require in-
tensive computations during their execution. These applications depend on High
Performance Computing (HPC) resources, which highlights the need for audi-

enabling more detailed and timely forecasts. The objective of this work is to
present the performance analyses and computational efficiency of the Model for

(MONAN), currently under development by INPE in partnership with MCTI,
